hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM that routes swaps entirely through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts via a custom bonding curve, takes input tokens and deposits them into Euler eVault positions, and withdraws output tokens from Euler eVaults — returning a full delta to bypass Uniswap concentrated liquidity. Supports optional pool expiration and protocol fees.
